/.title: Yuva Gharat – Product Designer
/.description: Yuva Gharat is a product designer (B.Des + M.Des, IDC School of Design) who makes technology a little less awkward around people.
p: I’m Yuva, & I make technology a
little less awkward around people by
A few of the works I’m proud of...
UX Study on AI in Education
I've worked across enterprise softwares, banking and visual design. This has given me different perspectives on design, from designing complex systems to everyday experiences.
Designed the UX for Azure Config Manager, an enterprise infrastructure-management platform.
Revamped SBM Bank India's consumer app end-to-end for 1L+ users.
Designed a sustainable recognition trophy for Capgemini employees.
Mentored 17 students for ePost Graduate Diploma in Interaction Design.
Led a 6-member mentor team and guided 11 first-year B.Des students.
Shaped the visual identity for Asia's largest college fest, reaching 150k+ footfall.
Winning poster entry 'Pali' for the theme ‘Typography and Sacred’
Met some awesome people along the way!
I've worn a few design hats, and interaction design fits me best.
I like to believe that a good design idea should outlive its context. That's how I hope to contribute to the larger design conversation.

Beyond design, I'm usually dancing or singing songs that nobody asked for. I take Sudoku far more seriously than a grown adult should, and collect hobbies faster than I finish them; board games, travel, and a camera I don't fully know how to use yet.
The closer I get to my goals, the further the goalpost seems to move. Maybe that's what’s so rewarding. So I'm still figuring things out, and I wouldn't have it any other way!
